post.text: Two years of specialised work by our #GIS and operations experts have enabled us to automatically identify #publicaccess where it exists in most NZ land parcels. This means our data set is more accurate and comprehensive because we can deal with exponentially more information.

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
